title: helichrysum arboreum
intro: Helichrysum arboreum, commonly known as the Yellow Candle or Mountain Curry, is a shrub-like perennial plant belonging to the daisy family. It is known for its golden flowers and has been used in traditional medicine for its numerous health benefits, including reducing inflammation, improving wound healing, and alleviating pain. The plant's therapeutic actions are attributed to its ability to exhibit anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which help to soothe and protect the body. The bioactive constituents present in Helichrysum arboreum include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenes, which contribute to its medicinal properties and make it a valuable natural remedy.
